criteria.criterion: Identity is the persistent COMMENT-HLC → Jira-comment-ID map, not the normalized-body key; verified by test_comment_duplicate_bodies_distinct_ids.

The returned add_comment {"id": …} is captured at both enactment sites (create_one; update_one→_update_one_dispatch_comments via handle_update / _apply_outbound_update) and persisted against the entry's local_comment_key via record_comment_id on Cloud (acli) and DC; verified by test_comment_id_captured_and_persisted.

Inbound-origin jira_comment_id (bug 85a1) and the outbound map are each authoritative for their own direction and never compete: the inbound differ is unchanged (ONLY RECONCILER_MARKER / jira_comment_id); the outbound differ skips when EITHER the key is mapped OR a jira_comment_id is present; verified by test_comment_bidirectional_identity_no_double_sync.
Comment sync is append-only both directions — new comments mirror once, edits/deletes skipped; verified by test_comment_append_only.

Outbound bodies render through RichTextCodec.to_wire: the Cloud ADF encode on the real create surface (--body json.dumps(to_wire(fitted))); fit-then-encode ordering; the a32a _resolve_codec injection migrated to the real codec; verified by test_comment_rendered_through_codec, test_comment_dedup_key_uses_real_codec, test_comment_adf_encode_fits_before_serialize.
After migration, DC comment-diff converges with zero duplicate re-post; verified by test_dc_comment_diff_converges_after_migration.
A repeat reconcile pass creates no duplicate comments; verified by test_comment_sync_idempotent.

Crash-durability: record_comment_id save()s immediately on the successful add_comment return and the demoted body-equality test stays a secondary skip, so a lost map write does not re-post; verified by test_comment_crash_between_add_and_map_save_no_duplicate.
The comment-ID map is change-gated, no per-pass churn; verified by test_comment_map_no_churn_on_no_new_comment_pass.
